show.name: La primera vez
show.summary: A mysterious teen girl arrives at an all-boys school in 1970s Colombia, breaking stereotypes, rules... and a few hearts.

episodes.name: Jane Eyre
episodes.summary: As major exams loom – and bring startling revelations — Camilo enlists the Acuña brothers for an illicit mission. José attempts to woo Ana.

episodes.name: Un tranvía llamado Deseo
episodes.summary: An impending military exam causes strife among Salcedo, Pabón, Castro and Arbeláez. A new play and a new face turn Salcedo's life upside down.

episodes.name: Sobre la fotografía
episodes.summary: A military draft throws the gang into disarray right before graduation. As Eva's life grows more complicated, so does her relationship with Camilo.

episodes.name: La increíble y triste historia de la cándida Eréndira y su abuela desalmada
episodes.summary: As the future unfolds, so do the group's opportunities. Lucy's announcement angers José. Pabón and Quiñonez clash in the military.

episodes.name: El señor de las moscas
episodes.summary: Camilo, Eva and the gang enter into a new chapter of their lives. Janet's suggestion takes José by surprise. Pabón turns the tables on Quiñonez.

episodes.name: El Kamasutra
episodes.summary: Pabón helps Quiñonez. As Camilo struggles with Eva's interest in their professor, a wild night unleashes his insecurities. Ana receives good news.

episodes.name: Lolita
episodes.summary: Camilo's jealousy blinds him as Eva's secrets mount. Pabón pushes back on the military's decision. José makes a special request of Camilo.

episodes.name: Siempre
episodes.summary: Reeling from Eva's decision, Camilo spirals. Salcedo's drug use presents consequences for the group. An idea gives Camilo a new opportunity.

episodes.name: El diario de Ana Frank
episodes.summary: As the police search for Eva, she comes clean about Silva's affiliations. An old face reunites with Salcedo and Luisa. A house party goes awry.

episodes.name: La peste
episodes.summary: Luisa and Arbeláez plan their future as a phone call urges Eva back to the U.S. Pabón confronts Quiñonez. Camilo falls deeper into the friend zone.
